scoring_justification: Proprietary COMPASS force field used in paper prevents absolute value comparison; only relative ordering of G_H and COF can be verified with open-source force fields.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed mechanical moduli, coefficient of friction, and abrasion rate for each of the four composites: pristine, COOCH3, OH, COOH. The checker will verify the relative ordering of G_H (COOH > OH > COOCH3 > pristine) and COF (COOH < OH < COOCH3 < pristine) as well as basic sanity (all moduli positive, G_H in (0.1,10) GPa, COF in (0,1)).

output_contract.notes: The task uses a public open-source force field instead of the proprietary COMPASS force field; therefore absolute numerical values may differ from the paper. Only the relative ordering of G_H and COF is scored. All construction parameters (cell sizes, functionalization details, NBR chain length, simulation durations) are provided in the instruction without revealing the target ordering.

steps.description: Extract G_H and COF for pristine, COOCH3, OH, COOH from results.csv and verify the ordering G_H: COOH > OH > COOCH3 > pristine (strictly decreasing) and COF: COOH < OH < COOCH3 < pristine (strictly increasing). Also confirm all moduli are positive, G_H in (0.1,10) GPa, and COF in (0,1).
